g.text: BOTTLE FILLER / 01 / Incoming power and motor starter
Revision B | Jack Lai | Simulation / engineering study | 2026-11-05
208 V, 3 phase, 60 Hz, grounded-wye only. Assumed available fault: 4 kA rms symmetrical.
Q0: incoming breaker. Q1: motor short-circuit protection. No selective trip coordination claimed.
OL1: 1.6-2.5 A range; simulated M1 nameplate 2.0 A; manual reset. Motor loss is outside enclosure.
Power: 14 AWG Cu design choice. PE: green/yellow, never switched or fused. No neutral required.
Concept study only. Upstream lockout/isolation, guarding and safety-rated stop need engineered review.
Reference conductors by net name across sheets. Crossings have no junction unless they share a terminal.
